# Alejandro Vizio

> Product & brand designer in San Francisco who designs product and brand as one system — partner and later CEO at Aerolab, design at Pachama (now Carbon Direct).

Alejandro Vizio (alevizio) designs the product and the brand as a single system, so the interface and the identity feel like one thing — from early concepts to polished design systems used by real people.

## Who is Alejandro Vizio?

Alejandro Vizio is a product and brand designer based in San Francisco. He is rare in owning BOTH the product (interface, UX, design systems) and the brand (identity, visual design) of a company. He has built and shaped companies at the owner and leadership level, with a climate-tech through-line.

## Companies

Owner & leadership level:
- Aerolab — partner from 2012, CEO 2018–2020 (8+ years)
- Pachama — design, 5+ years (climate tech; acquired by Carbon Direct in 2025)

Product & brand work:
- Planta, Messa, Earthscale, Limai, Fudo, Djooni

## Expertise

- Product design (UX/UI, interaction, design systems)
- Brand design & identity
- Climate & sustainability design (via Pachama, Earthscale)

## Outside design

- DJ and music producer (electronic music)

## Timeline, 1985–2026

In his own words, from the timeline at the foot of https://alevizio.com (also at https://alevizio.com/about#timeline).

- 1985: born in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
- 1986: moved to Madrid, Spain.
- 1986: Argentina won the World Cup.
- 1989: primary school at [King's College](https://www.madrid-soto.kingscollegeschools.org/en) in Madrid.
- 1995: moved to the US, to Lake Forest, Illinois.
- 1995: started junior high there.
- 1998: back to Buenos Aires, to [St George's College](https://stgeorges.edu.ar/).
- 2000: started [djing](https://soundcloud.com/alevizio) at fiestas de 15.
- 2003: finished high school.
- 2004: started graphic design at [ORT](https://www.ort.edu.ar/).
- 2006: finished graphic design at [ORT](https://www.ort.edu.ar/), then started visual communication design at [UNR](https://unr.edu.ar/).
- 2006: digital image design at [Image Campus](https://www.imagecampus.edu.ar/).
- 2007: graphic designer at [Arthur Newton Communications](https://www.arthur-newton.com/).
- 2007: a year of web design at [Image Campus](https://www.imagecampus.edu.ar/).
- 2008: ran [adidas](https://www.adidas.com.ar/)' Proyecto Potreros at [Arthur Newton Communications](https://www.arthur-newton.com/): football pitches in 23 towns.
- 2009: art direction at Underground.
- 2010: Potreros won a silver FIP.
- 2012: joined [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/), founded by [Roberto Gonzalez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robertogonzalez/) and [Agustin Linenberg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/agustinlinenberg/), as art director and third partner.
- 2013: creative director at [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/).
- 2013: [Lemon Wallet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lemon_Wallet)'s marketing site.
- 2013: [MURAL](https://www.mural.co/)'s first branding, back when it was Mural.ly.
- 2013: [Breach](https://github.com/spolu/breach_core), a browser in JavaScript, and [AcáNoHayLuz](https://acanohayluz.com/), a map of power cuts.
- 2014: [Juani Ruiz Echazu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/heyimjuani/) joined [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/) as the fourth partner.
- 2014: [Popcorn Time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Popcorn_Time) launched: movies streamed over BitTorrent, to more than 100 million people.
- 2014: took Popcorn Time to [Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/) on my first trip to San Francisco; didn't get in.
- 2014: helped organize [JSConf Argentina](https://aerolab.co/jsconf) and did all its visuals.
- 2014: [GestureKit](https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/josevigil/gesturekit-gesture-commands-for-mobile-interfaces) and its Indiegogo launch.
- 2015: a new mobile banking app for [Banco Galicia](https://aerolab.co/banco-galicia).
- 2015: a new brand and apps for Streema's [Simple Radio](https://aerolab.co/simpleradio).
- 2015: taught [product design](https://platzi.com/cursos/product-designer/) at [Platzi](https://platzi.com/), in Bogotá.
- 2017: moved to San Francisco as [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/)'s US manager.
- 2017: taught UX design at [Digital House](https://www.digitalhouse.com/).
- 2017: took [Pampa Warro](https://pampawarro.org/) to [Fuego Austral](https://fuegoaustral.org/), for the first time.
- 2018: became [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/)'s CEO.
- 2018: [Cartoon Network's site](https://aerolab.co/cartoon-network).
- 2018: [Lullaby](https://uselullaby.com/), a free treatment for tinnitus.
- 2018: [Singularity University](https://www.su.org/)'s executive program in innovation.
- 2018: joined [EO](https://eonetwork.org/), the Entrepreneurs' Organization.
- 2018: my O-1B visa for individuals with extraordinary ability in the arts was approved.
- 2019: my son Silvestre was born.
- 2019: got my green card.
- 2019: uploaded my first set to SoundCloud: [Tropical Disco](https://soundcloud.com/alevizio/tropical-disco).
- 2019: [Aerolab](https://aerolab.co/) made Forbes Argentina's [30 Promesas](https://www.forbesargentina.com/liderazgo/30-promesas-forbes-2019-emprendedores-estan-construyendo-futuro-n1324).
- 2020: joined [Pachama](https://pachama.com) as a product designer.
- 2021: design systems with [Nielsen Norman Group](https://www.nngroup.com/).
- 2022: gave “design systems para todos” at [Friends of Figma Medellín](https://friends.figma.com/events/details/figma-medellin-presents-design-systems-para-todos/).
- 2022: took [Joya](https://joya-art.org/), an art piece, to [Burning Man](https://burningman.org/).
- 2022: Argentina won the World Cup again.
- 2023: seed investor in [ComplexChaos](https://www.builtinsf.com/company/complexchaos).
- 2024: senior product designer at [Pachama](https://pachama.com).
- 2024: taught UX experts at [Mercado Libre](https://www.mercadolibre.com.ar/), with [Edison](https://somosedison.com/).
- 2025: [Pachama](https://pachama.com) was [acquired by Carbon Direct](https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/10/consolidation-begins-to-hit-the-carbon-credit-market/); stayed on as senior product designer.
- 2025: product & brand for [Earthscale](https://www.earthscale.ai/), [Limai](https://www.limai.io/) and [Fudo](https://fu.do/).
- 2025: Brad Frost's [Atomic Design certification course](https://courses.bradfrost.com/courses/atomic-design).
- 2025: became a US citizen.
- 2026: founding designer at [Bocho](https://www.bocho.com/) ([Planta](https://www.planta.co/)).
- 2026: founding designer at [Djooni](https://djooni.com).
- 2026: the website for [Messa](https://messa.ai/), product & brand for [Pausa](https://www.pausa.co/).
- 2026: [globestudio](https://globestudio.app) — open-source dotted maps & 3d globes.
- 2026: [curb](https://curb.guide/) — know where to park in sf. in [SFGate](https://www.sfgate.com/local/article/sf-street-sweeping-app-22317534.php) and [The Dissent SF](https://thedissentsf.com/article/after-2-000-in-sweeping-tickets-a-haight-developer-read-the-city-s-own-data).
- 2026: [saboteurs](https://saboteurs.app/) — squad stealth for iphone, in beta.
